messages:
maeve: Quick design sync — compact threshold rows now allow channel folding. Question: when channels are collapsed, should we hide notification previews or show a summarized line? toni: Summarize. Hiding removes important context for triage. Suggest: "3 channels • 2 previews" as a condensed preview. Keeps height small. :thinking_face: devin: Summarize + make expand affordance more touch-friendly. Chevron currently <44px on mobile. Need 44px targets. alex: Copy thought: change 'Show previews' to 'Preview notifications'. For collapsed label: '3 channels collapsed — view previews' (link-style). Feels actionable. maeve: Accessibility: screen reader should announce count + previews. Proposed aria-label: "3 channels collapsed, 2 previews available, expandable" accessibility-bot: AUTOMATED CHECK: aria-label present? NO — collapsed rows failing. Example fix below. maeve: Snippet we expect:
3
toni: Keyboard flow: Enter expands but Tab currently jumps to next threshold row. Need to move focus into first expanded child or trap focus until user closes. devin: Preview content should be single-line truncated with matching-rule highlight. Example: "[MATCH] high error rate service-x: 87%". Keep under 100 chars. maeve: Edge case: mixed suppression states across collapsed channels. Show stacked micro-badges (muted • snoozed) and expand tooltip listing exact states. Don't clutter row. alex: Tooltip copy for suppression toggle: keep button label 'Snooze' but tooltip: 'Temporarily silence notifications'. PM feedback shows this clarifies intent. toni: Visual density: avoid two-line collapsed rows. Ellipsize channel names and reveal full on hover. accessibility-bot: AUTOMATED CHECK: contrast for chevrons/badges borderline (~3.8:1). Recommend 4.5:1 for small text WCAG AA. devin: Impl notes: animate expand over 120ms. Use JS-set max-height to avoid animating auto. Lazy-load preview content to prevent perf hits. Add unit tests for keyboard focus behavior. maeve: Decision list for Figma update: keep single-line compact row; show summary badge '3 channels • 2 previews'; enlarge chevron touch target; add aria-label announcement; keyboard expand moves focus to first child; include tiny badges for mute/snooze; tooltip copy tweak. Comments? toni: No objections. Will update Figma + design doc. devin: I'll implement aria + focus behavior and add tests. alex: I'll update copy doc and tooltip text. maeve: Thanks — I'll post updated screenshots and QA checklist when done. :thumbsup:
